description: Land Acquisition - Nawinna, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that certain described lands are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed descriptions of the specific land lots, their extents, and boundaries. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4), which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
